name: NIRO
descriptionZh: 通过 Mac Bridge 在 iPhone 上访问 Kimi Code 等智能体的受支持会话、查看进度并发送后续指令。
descriptionEn: An iPhone companion for supported Kimi Code sessions and other agents through a local Mac Bridge.

kimiEvidence.note: The release documentation identifies Kimi Code as a local ACP integration; desktop-native live synchronization is not fully verified.

bodyZh: NIRO 是面向多个桌面智能体的 iPhone 客户端，包含 Kimi Code 本地 ACP 接入。安装 iOS 16+ 的 NIRO 与 macOS 13+ 的 Niro Bridge，配置电脑端 Kimi Code 后配对连接。桌面原生会话实时同步尚未完全验证，功能因 Agent 而异。公开仓库提供安装包与文档，应用源码未公开。
bodyEn: NIRO is an iPhone companion for several desktop agents, including a local ACP integration with Kimi Code. Install NIRO (iOS 16+) and Niro Bridge (macOS 13+), configure Kimi Code on the Mac, then pair. Desktop-native live synchronization is not fully verified; features vary by agent. The public repository distributes installers and documentation; app source is not public.
